task: Final tier (last message before TCA) from messages with time_to_tca >= 2 days (organisers)

methods.persistence_miss: Persistence: miss-distance tier at latest >=2 d message
methods.reference_persistence_risk: REFERENCE ONLY: risk + miss tier at latest >=2 d (uses the label column)
methods.model_argmax_unbounded: Ablation: model argmax, no floor (not shipped)
methods.bounded_rule_floor: Ablation: bounded, Pc-only Elevated left as is
methods.second_look_forecast: Second Look forecast (bounded: floor + model escalation)

decision_layer.floor: Critical if the latest >=2 d message is Critical by rule (never lowered); else max(miss tier, team nowcast tier) - Pc-only Elevated lowered only by the constrained demoter
decision_layer.escalation: to Critical if P(final Critical) >= t_crit; to Elevated if P(final >= Elevated) >= t_elev
decision_layer.t_crit_rule: loosest threshold reaching 95% final-Critical recall on out-of-fold scores of the training portion
decision_layer.t_elev_rule: maximises F2 of final >= Elevated on the same out-of-fold scores
decision_layer.probabilities: scores of a class-weighted model: they rank events but overstate rare tiers; not calibrated probabilities

secondary_cohort_kalent_8293.definition: >= 1 message 2+ days out and final message < 1 day (ESA Kelvins protocol); scored from the 5-fold CV out-of-fold predictions

test_predictions.note: test_data has no final outcomes: these are demo predictions, never scored
